setting.label: 12th century CE · late Heian and Genpei narrative frame
setting.note: The 097000 manuscript explicitly places the Taira story in late-twelfth-century Japan. This broad century identifies the main narrative frame, including the 1180–83 wars named in its scope; embedded memories and subsequent textual transmission are distinct.
